custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with vendor A, whose description contains the word NOTCHED, so the word not also matches it on its description.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither word, so the search has a part it must leave out.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then the button that starts a new return).

Setup

  1. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 VENDOR A in Name *. Click Save & Close.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839424-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Track quantities and cost of goods off. Click Save.
  3. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 NOTCHED PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839424-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
  4. Make part C: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C839424 PART C; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839424-C; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Vendor: vendor A; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
